heading.en: Why do flower prices jump at festivals?

hook.en: Before Dasara, the price of marigold flowers shoots up; after a bumper harvest, tomato prices crash. Shifts in demand and supply explain both.
hook.kn: ದಸರಾ ಮೊದಲು ಚೆಂಡು ಹೂವಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಗಗನಕ್ಕೇರುತ್ತದೆ; ಭಾರಿ ಫಸಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಬೆಲೆ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರೈಕೆಯ ಸರಿತಗಳು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Show the effect of a shift in demand on equilibrium
Show the effect of a shift in supply on equilibrium

narration.en: Before Dasara, the price of marigold flowers shoots up; after a bumper harvest, tomato prices crash. Shifts in demand and supply explain both.
narration.kn: ದಸರಾ ಮೊದಲು ಚೆಂಡು ಹೂವಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಗಗನಕ್ಕೇರುತ್ತದೆ; ಭಾರಿ ಫಸಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಬೆಲೆ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರೈಕೆಯ ಸರಿತಗಳು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: With the number of firms fixed, if demand increases (rightward shift, for example because income rises for a normal good or tastes change), there is excess demand at the old price, so both equilibrium price and quantity rise. If demand decreases (leftward shift), there is excess supply at the old price, so both equilibrium price and quantity fall.

narration.en: If demand increases, equilibrium price and quantity both rise. If demand decreases, both fall.
narration.kn: ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಬೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಎರಡೂ ಏರುತ್ತವೆ. ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಎರಡೂ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Start at equilibrium E: price 10, quantity 200.
Income rises: demand shifts right by 50 at every price. The new equilibrium is at price 12 and quantity 230.
Now instead supply increases by 50. The new equilibrium is at price 8 and quantity 220: price falls, quantity rises.

narration.en: Start at equilibrium E: price 10, quantity 200.

body.en: If supply increases (rightward shift, for example because of better technology, lower input prices or a good harvest), there is excess supply at the old price, so equilibrium price falls and quantity rises. If supply decreases (leftward shift, for example because of a unit tax or crop failure), equilibrium price rises and quantity falls.

narration.en: If supply increases, price falls and quantity rises. If supply decreases, price rises and quantity falls.
narration.kn: ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ಬೆಲೆ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಬೆಲೆ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Shift demand and supply: qD = 300 + d − 10p, qS = 50 + s + 15p. The white lines are the original curves.

tryThis.en: Set d = 50, s = 0. Do price and quantity both rise?
Set d = 0, s = 50. Which way does price move?

narration.en: Shift demand and supply: qD = 300 + d − 10p, qS = 50 + s + 15p. The white lines are the original curves.

problem.en: qD = 300 − 10p, qS = 50 + 15p. (a) Income rises and demand becomes qD = 350 − 10p. (b) Instead, technology improves and supply becomes qS = 100 + 15p. Find the new equilibrium in each case.

answer.en: (a) p = ₹12, q = 230 (both rise); (b) p = ₹8, q = 220 (price falls, quantity rises).

narration.en: Let us work this out together. qD = 300 − 10p, qS = 50 + 15p. (a) Income rises and demand becomes qD = 350 − 10p. (b) Instead, technology improves and supply becomes qS = 100 + 15p. Find the new equilibrium in each case.

heading.en: Demand moves them together, supply splits them

body.en: A demand shift moves price and quantity in the same direction. A supply shift moves them in opposite directions.

narration.en: Demand moves them together, supply splits them. A demand shift moves price and quantity in the same direction. A supply shift moves them in opposite directions.

mnemonic.en: D: same way; S: opposite way

narration.en: Supply is qS = 50 + 15p. In the festival season demand rises to qD = 400 − 10p. Find the new equilibrium price.

prompt.en: Supply is qS = 50 + 15p. In the festival season demand rises to qD = 400 − 10p. Find the new equilibrium price.

explanation.en: 400 − 10p = 50 + 15p gives 25p = 350, p = ₹14 (it was ₹10 before the rise).

homework.en: Explain with a diagram the effect of a rise in the price of tea on the market for coffee.

narration.en: Recap. Demand ↑: price and quantity rise; demand ↓: both fall. Supply ↑: price falls, quantity rises. Supply ↓: price rises, quantity falls.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆ: ಬೆಲೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಏರಿಕೆ; ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಇಳಿಕೆ: ಎರಡೂ ಇಳಿಕೆ. ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆ: ಬೆಲೆ ಇಳಿಕೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಏರಿಕೆ. ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಇಳಿಕೆ: ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿಕೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಇಳಿಕೆ.
